status: outcome-blind executable inference artifact; not a preregistration or run authorization

exactly 3 Native-first templates in each 6-template structural variant

synthetic_mechanics_check.evidentiary_value: none; deterministic synthetic values exercise the frozen implementation and are not provider outcomes

monte_carlo_error.scope: bounds simulation CDF error only; does not bound statistical interval coverage error

claim_boundaries: The exact p-value is valid for the sharp null under the frozen constrained arm-order mechanism; it is not a power calculation or a test of a superiority margin.

Missingness, safety conjunctions, multiplicity, provider drift, and endpoint construction still require final preregistration rules.
The synthetic mechanics check has no efficacy or provider-comparison evidentiary value.
This artifact authorizes zero provider calls and zero efficacy claims.
